text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe camp is over already... It
really
went by in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Next month is the Sprinters S...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono mentioned that she
wanted to
take on the Sprinters S. next.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But we still don't know if she should try
to lose
weight and participate in a lower
weight class or
tackle it as she is now.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
choice_data_list: (Either way, it's going to be a painful choice)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
There's no way of knowing what'll
happen in the
future...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So let's just stay positive, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, my blistering summer
camp
experience with Hishi Akebono
draws to an end.
